# defectdojo_product_type (List Resource)

Lists the DefectDojo product types the provider user may see, ordered by name.

Requires Terraform 1.14 or later. Terraform returns at most 100 results unless the `list` block sets `limit`. `terraform query -generate-config-out` writes every attribute that has a value, including those the provider otherwise leaves to others when they are not configured (such as `authorized_users` and `tags`): remove the ones another system manages before applying the generated configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find the product types, and generate import blocks and configuration with:
#   terraform query -generate-config-out=generated.tf
# Terraform returns at most 100 results unless limit is set.
list "defectdojo_product_type" "all" {
  provider = defectdojo
  limit    = 1000
}

# Only product types whose name contains "web", ignoring case
list "defectdojo_product_type" "web" {
  provider = defectdojo

  config {
    name_contains = "web"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_contains` (String) Only list the product types whose name contains this text, ignoring case.
